item.title: Understanding Kakuro Rules and Grid Mechanics
item.description: You open the puzzle book to the Kakuro page, uncap the pen, and look at the first clue cell. It holds two numbers, 24 and 16, separated by a diagonal line. Which one goes with the row? You pick the 24, spend five minutes building a combination that adds up to it across two cells, and realize two cells can’t add up to more than 17. The math was fine. You just solved the wrong clue.
